fact: The Minister of Finance and Development Planning told Parliament on 19 February 2025 that the Government of Lesotho Enterprise Architecture and Interoperability Framework is being developed to improve efficiency and avoid fragmented ICT deployment across government.
system: Government of Lesotho Enterprise Architecture and Interoperability Framework

fact: The Government of Lesotho issued Terms of Reference for development of the Government of Lesotho Enterprise Architecture (GLEA) and a standalone e-Government Interoperability (e-GIF) Framework; the document's landing page is dated 22 July 2024 and its body text was not retrievable.

The 2024 strategy cites the absence of an overarching digital government architecture, gaps in interoperability, and says a digital government interoperability framework should be defined and implemented, listing it as a very high priority action led by MICSTI; no framework is reported as existing or in drafting.

fact: Qualisys Consulting says it is supporting Lesotho's Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation in developing the e-Government Interoperability Framework (eGIF) alongside a Government Enterprise Architecture (GLEA).
